types.name: rate_id
types.description:
The associated rate's ID.
When integrating with a third-party, you don't need to provide it.
This is mainly used for the built-in rates.

types.name: rate
types.description: The rate of the tax line.

types.name: code
types.description: The code of the tax line.

types.name: name
types.description: The name of the tax line.

types.name: provider_id
types.description: The ID of the tax provider used to calculate and retrieve the tax line.

types.name: data
types.description:
Additional data returned by the tax provider.
Use this to store jurisdiction-level breakdown data
(e.g. state, county, city rates) that is not captured in the aggregated rate.
